1090905.name: Camp Gan Israel South Padre Island Texas
1090905.note: Lubavitch.com (3 Aug 2006, 'Experimental Camp A Success'; also CrownHeights.info, 30 July 2006): Camp Gan Israel on South Padre Island's '2006 summer session' was its first: 'this newly founded camp is a longtime dream of Rabbis Asher Hecht and Eli Laber'; 'The theme of this inaugural summer was an instructive-based water camp'; 'In this inaugural year' it took only Texas children. Chabad.org (11 July 2007) describes its next summer. Rabbi Asher Hecht (Chabad of the Rio Grande Valley) directs it.

2259836.name: Hillel Academy
2259836.note: IRS: Hillel Academy Of Tarrant County (Fort Worth), ruling Oct 2014, so it existed by then. The school in Haltom City; school leader Rabbi Dov Mandel (Chabad of Fort Worth, there since 2002). Its first year is not found. Lead: its chabad.org listing (2259836) is from about 2013.

5215392.name: Maayan Chai
5215392.note: Texas Jewish Post, 1 April 2010 (p. 8, on The Portal to Texas History): Maayan Chai, a nonprofit offering Jewish learning, business networking and one-on-one advice, launched by Gavin Kam with Dan (now Rabbi) Lewin, who had hosted Sinai Cafe and studied at the Mayanot yeshiva in Jerusalem; its Sinai Cafe division holds Shabbat gatherings like those the Lewins hosted at their Chabad center in Binghamton. So there by April 2010. Lead: a search summary of that page says it was founded in 2009 (by Kam, Rabbi Dan and Yael Lewin and Shane Stein); the page itself could not be opened from here (certificate error, then 503), so not used as a year.
